policy: new descriptors fixed before re-run; chosen on scientific merit, not to favor any candidate

algorithm.name: Host-Guest Complementary Pathway Screening Algorithm
algorithm.mlPolicy: No training or inference is used. Dataset fields and curated tables are aggregated by fixed rules.

proxyValidity.decision: Retain the composite pore signal at reduced influence. Do not treat surface area or void fraction as sufficient standalone reaction proxies.

familyFairness.decision: Keep family-level scoring but expose sample size, IQR outliers, and dominant records. Low confidence does not silently change a score.

rankingSensitivity.decision: Descriptor expansion is not calibrated to restore Al-MOF to rank 1.

dataReality.linker: CoRE linker labels are populated, but no quantitative ligand-property fields exist. Ligand chemistry uses a transparent curated table.
dataReality.synthesizability: No direct synthesis-difficulty field exists. Family frequency in CoRE plus literature is a data-derived maturity proxy, with explicit curated difficulty multipliers only where documented.
dataReality.economics: No price field exists. Economics uses a curated precursor-price table and a transparent life-cycle-cost proxy with TODO verification labels.

hgcpsFormula: finalHGCPS = product(max(factor, 0.001) ^ routeWeight); route weights sum to 1

poreEnvironmentScore.descriptor: surface area, pore volume, and void fraction structural support
poreEnvironmentScore.aggregate: family median for each numeric field; combined as mean of normalized field medians
poreEnvironmentScore.auditNote: Retained at reduced host weight because the composite tracks reaction performance, while surface area and void fraction alone have low validity.

co2EnrichmentSupport.descriptor: CO2 adsorption support combined with ligand chemistry

ligandPathwaySupport.descriptor: frequency-weighted ligand chemistry support for CO2 affinity, Lewis basicity, and active-site environment
ligandPathwaySupport.aggregate: 0.20 * normalized carboxylateCount + 0.25 * nDonorOrAmine + 0.15 * normalized aromaticRings + 0.15 * openMetalSitePropensity tier + 0.25 * Lewis basicity tier; family value is linker-frequency weighted
ligandPathwaySupport.normalization: descriptor bounds and preregistered tier values
ligandPathwaySupport.fallback: Unmapped or pending linker labels use 0.5 and are labeled fallback with the missing linker names.

stabilityProxy.descriptor: indirect aqueous survival proxy from water/aqueous reaction presence plus CoRE representation
stabilityProxy.aggregate: 0.7 * valid aqueous reaction share + 0.3 * normalized CoRE family record count

aqueousStabilityEvidence.aggregate: share of family reaction rows with water or aqueous solvent, yield > 0, and accepted validation status

thermalStabilityEvidence.aggregate: median family reaction temperature among positive-yield accepted rows

postModificationFeasibility.aggregate: curated fallback because no imported dataset field represents this descriptor

guestHostingFeasibility.aggregate: curated fallback because no imported dataset field represents this descriptor

synthesizabilityScore.aggregate: min-max normalize log1p(CoRE family records + literature family records), then multiply by an explicit curated difficulty multiplier when present
synthesizabilityScore.normalization: cross-family min-max after log1p frequency; clamp 0-1
synthesizabilityScore.fallback: If both source counts are zero, use 0.25 and label fallback.

provenanceQuality.aggregate: mean available provenance coverage for mapped records, falling back to DOI/citation coverage

guestFactorMappings.dataDerivedPolicy: Only derive a guest factor from reaction/literature/gold records when the guest metal appears as a primary metalNode with nRecords >= threshold. Otherwise use the existing literature prior and label fallback.
guestFactorMappings.performanceAggregate: mean of normalized yield, selectivity, and conversion across eligible records
guestFactorMappings.fallbackReason: No dedicated dopant or guest-metal dataset field is present in the imported data.

hostGuestComplementarityScore.source: rule-derived from host stability, host pathway support, and guest activity

economicScore.source: curated metal precursor price table + LCC proxy
economicScore.aggregate: estimatedCost = 0.65 * hostMetalUSDkg + 0.20 * guestMetalUSDkg + 0.10 * ligandCostTierUSDkg + 0.05 * synthesisEnergyIndexUSDkg; economicScore = inverse min-max estimatedCost across routes
economicScore.boundary: Placeholder prices remain TODO verify price + source and are not measured process costs.

Ti-MOF.basis: Preregistered penalty for narrower precursor/reactivity windows and hydrolysis control reported for titanium-carboxylate MOF synthesis.
Ti-MOF.todo: TODO: user chemistry review of multiplier and supporting source.

economics.boundary: Curated placeholder inputs support transparent relative screening only; they are not supplier quotations or a full process LCC.
